newsitem.title: USA: US Plains cattle feedlots quiet, no sales - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains cattle feedlots quiet, no sales - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets near midday Tuesday were quiet, with no reported sales, feedlot sources said.
Packer bids at $63.00 per cwt were passed by owners seeking $65.00 to $66.00, several sources said.
Actual prices on sales, once they occur, will likely be $64.00, steady with last week's top prices, sources said.
Light sales of about 500 steers occured Monday in the Texas Panhandle/western Oklahoma area at $64.00, USDA said.
